grammar: Each key starts with lowercase ASCII letter; remaining lowercase ASCII letters/digits/underscore; no colon or @ within keys.
global_uniqueness: Unique namespace/key, one approved owner per namespace; semantic duplication review across namespaces.
ownership_transfer: Owner assignment changes without changing ID.
cross_pack_reuse: Pinned dependency references original canonical ID; never duplicate ID under another domain.
rename: Display-label update preserves ID; semantic key is immutable.
